name: Kannada Text Detection in Video Frames
tagline: Detecting Kannada text in real-world video frames
lede: A computer-vision pipeline exploring text-region detection in Kannada news-video frames under blur, low resolution, and changing scene conditions.
highlights: Extracts frames from Kannada news videos using OpenCV for dataset preparation.
Explores text-region proposals and YOLOv8-based detection, with a focus on Kannada script in real-world footage.
Includes annotation, dataset organization, augmentation, training, and inference workflows.
The project is being developed to train and evaluate a custom detector rather than rely on a pretrained OCR engine for the core detection task.

name: SkillNest — Online Learning Platform
tagline: A web platform for learning and course management
lede: An online learning platform project built around course discovery, learning workflows, and a web-based user experience.
highlights: Built as a full-stack web-development project using a Node.js and Express backend.
Designed to bring learning content and course workflows into one application.

name: Pharmacy Management System
tagline: A software project for pharmacy workflows
lede: A pharmacy-management application project focused on organizing common inventory and medicine-management workflows.
highlights: Created as an academic software project.
Focused on organizing common medicine and pharmacy-management workflows.

name: PulseChat
lede: An exploration of an offline messaging experience that could communicate across nearby devices without depending on constant internet access.
highlights: Explores mesh-network ideas and offline-first messaging.
Android direction: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
Cross-platform support is a future consideration, not a completed feature.
